name: Vision suite

modules.build: Dark mode status bar, time 9:41 left, battery/signal right.
Back icon (<), Title 'Vision *suite*' (Newsreader Medium Italic on 'suite'), Right actions: bell icon, info icon. Target 44px.

Glass surface, r28, orange glow top center. Overline 'EYE CARE TODAY'. Body: 'Exercise: 2 min remaining'. Caption muted: 'Last eye test: non-diagnostic'. ChipProvenance: 'via wellbeing log'. State: default.
Pills: Eye test | Exercises | Strain | Progress. Underline active 'Exercises' with accent #FF5E00. Solid #211008 bg, radius 16. 44px targets.
Solid surface, r24. H3 '20-20-20 reset'. Body: 'Look 20 feet away for 20 sec'. ProgressRing (orange, member-effort) to left. BtnPrimary 'Start eye exercise' #FF5E00 right.
Solid #211008. Overline 'TREND'. Caption: 'Mon low | Tue medium | Wed low'. ChipProvenance: 'via strain log · 3 entries' (real: not fewer than three logged entries).
Glass surface. Bold text: 'Not a diagnosis. Sudden vision changes need a clinician.' BtnSecondary border only: 'Find urgent guidance'.
Pill nav with icons: Today | CIA | Goals | Me. Transparent glass background. CIA tab label uses accent #7F24FF.

belowFold.build: Solid #211008. Overline 'DATA CONTROLS'. ChipProvenance: 'category: health · source: device · scope: screen time · freshness: today · retention: 30d · export · revoke · delete'. Body text explaining consent and non-diagnostic nature.

imageSlots.prompt: Vision suite eye-test and exercise visuals, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.

trustControls: Names health category, source, freshness, confidence, retention, export, revoke, and delete before synced values or photo-derived reads are trusted.
Media is consent-gated: no identifiable face, body, home, document, provider logo, or private text appears without explicit permission.
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete.
Non-diagnostic disclaimer and urgent guidance stay visible on default and error states, reachable without gamification.
Provenance chips attached to all stats, trends, and cross-signal recommendations; no fabricated eye test scores or strain values.
notes: Reduced-motion: disable ProgressRing sweep, TrendChart draw, and glow breathing; show static elapsed time text.

Accessibility: AA+ contrast on #0A0A0F and #211008 backgrounds; tabs, timer controls, guidance links, and delete controls are at least 44px targets. Screen readers announce non-diagnostic status before any test result.
